findings.label: OAuth token refresh gap
findings.description: When a Credentials object is missing refresh_token, the refresh attempt catches and silently continues. This could send expired access_token to YouTube API, which then fails with YT_AUTH_FAILED (permanent, no retry). Consider checking token.expiry before refresh to distinguish between still-valid and expired-unrefreshable cases.

findings.label: Prompt injection sanitization incomplete
findings.description: The regex patterns in _sanitize_input are basic and match only exact phrase structure. Attackers can obfuscate with extra whitespace, unicode tricks, or variant phrasings. Not a blocker (fallback is safe), but should be documented as a known limitation.

findings.label: Metadata placeholder in job runner
findings.description: _youtube_publish_job passes render.song_id (a UUID) as song_title to generate_metadata, not the actual song title. Should join from VideoRender → Song. This doesn't break functionality but is a logic error that should be fixed before production.

findings.label: Unused error classification function
findings.description: _classify_error returns True/False for retryable errors, but is not used in _youtube_publish_job. The job always sets status='failed' and relies on external scheduler to inspect error_code. Either remove the function or document the external retry contract.
